bio: Two concepts under one roof. Menue is the cosy, modern little locale serving a six-course set menu that changes monthly, plus finger food to start and petits fours to finish. The delicious food is creative and ingredient-led – seasonal produce and a penchant for regional ingredients. You can also plump for the "sharing" format of the set menu. Service is friendly and attentive – the chef, too, serves up dishes himself. The second eatery is the Bistro, which delivers a slightly simpler culinary offering. In case you were wondering, the restaurant's name comes from the expression "aus der Lameng" and means "spontaneous, relaxed, off the cuff" – and that is indeed the motto by which they live here.
